mstts:express-as.prosody:
Welcome, and thanks for joining me on this journey. Have you ever wondered how questions of identity, gender, or self-worth shape the way we move through life? These questions are always in the background, influencing the choices we make and the way we see ourselves. Together, we’re going to explore what it really means to be a woman in our fast-changing world—a world full of expectations, traditions, and bold new possibilities.
With Caitlin Moran’s book, How to Be a Woman, as our guide, we’ll dive into the ups and downs of modern womanhood. Moran brings a mix of sharp humor, honesty, and fearless storytelling, making even the toughest topics feel relatable. We’ll walk through everything from the awkwardness of growing up to the real challenges of love, career, and motherhood. Along the way, we’ll talk about feminism, body image, relationships, and the unspoken rules that women deal with every single day.
What if we could laugh at the things that used to make us feel ashamed? Or turn vulnerability into strength, and honesty into a way to connect with others? That’s the spirit of this conversation—a place where humor helps us survive and where every story, no matter how messy, has the power to inspire.
So, let’s get ready to question the status quo, celebrate what makes each of us unique, and discover what it really means to write our own story. I’m glad you’re here. Let’s explore it together.
